snippet.title: JOLLY: Let's Party | Official Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Today is the long-awaited premiere day of our first official teaser trailer! After months of hard work, we can finally bring you this short animated teaser, just a minute and a half long, where you can experience our beloved environments.

Go Follow JOLLY: Let's Party on Gamejolt ► https://gamejolt.com/games/JLP/796034
Join our Discord server ► https://discord.gg/zFE7FSSKv8

JOLLY: Let's Party is a fangame of the JOLLY saga created by Ivang, programmed in Unity taking inspiration from several Mascot Horror titles

It is a first-person game divided into 3 chapters of the same duration each in the same freeroam game with a unique story that the player can explore with a single definitive ending

Step into the new and improved Jolly's Fantasy World and work with us as a night guard, taking care of our beloved and colorful animatronic PartyTronics. But be warned: if you suffer any scratches, injuries, or trauma during your shift, the company is not responsible.

Coming soon!
